props.name: fallback
props.description: What to show instead of a failed subtree: a node, or a function that gets the error and a `reset`. Omit for the built-in panel with a retry button.

props.name: resetKeys
props.description: Values the subtree depends on. When any of them changes while the fallback is showing, the boundary resets itself — pick another record and the error goes.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called once per caught error, with React’s component stack. Report it from here.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Called after the boundary clears its error, with what caused it.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: Label of the built-in fallback’s retry button.
